user_request: Live reasoning text before the answer, like thinking-model interfaces.

sources.finding: IBM describes the4.1 language family as non-reasoning models optimized without long chains of thought.

IBM documents native reasoning in Granite4.2, with think tags and enable_thinking modes; sizes include3B. The documentation site warns it is no longer updated, so consult current model card before implementation.

conclusion: No supported native thinking display established for the current4.1 checkpoint. Streaming its generated output would not expose a separate ungenerated reasoning trace. A reasoning-capable checkpoint supports a different experiment.
research_constraint: Do not assume the current layer/channel coordinates or doses transfer to a different model.
